explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/478: for prime p let A_p = {k! mod p : 1 ≤ k < p}; is |A_p| ∼ (1 − 1/e) p? The Lean statement: along primes (atTop ⊓ principal {p prime}), |image of k ↦ k! % p over k ∈ [1, p)| / p → 1 − 1/e. This is exactly the asymptotic |A_p| ∼ (1 − 1/e)p, stated in 'yes' form per the question convention. Faithful.
